name: Jay A. Tremblay
office: Antelope Valley-East Kern Water Agency, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Jay A. Tremblay is the incumbent Director for Division 3 on the Antelope Valley-East Kern Water Agency Board of Directors. He serves on the board's Water Rates and Capacity Fees Committee. He also serves on the Customer Relations and Public Information Committee.
